product_one_liner.value: Wellinks provides virtual pulmonary rehabilitation, personalized clinical coaching, and remote patient monitoring for people with COPD and other cardiopulmonary conditions, working with health plans and providers.
product_one_liner.notes: Product and audiences are described on the company homepage and its payer/provider page.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link; no public pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: The testimonials page contains individual member stories, not customer organizations. News results identify organizations such as CareAbout Health as a partner, not as a customer; no two named customers could be substantiated.

hq_location.notes: Company and PitchBook profiles identify New Haven, Connecticut.

founded_year.notes: The company acquisition announcement says Wellinks was founded in 2012; PitchBook agrees. A separate 2021 release says the present entity was established in 2019 through merger, but the stated founding year is 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The accessible blog/news index shows company news and marketing/product material, not two engineer-authored technical posts.

public_docs.notes: The public Knowledge Base has multiple support and product articles, including device setup, app use, and COPD-related materials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists a Senior Data and BI Analyst position, but no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: Public product, privacy, and company material describes AI-powered predictive analytics but does not identify an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Wellinks provides a HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices. No SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification claim was substantiated in the reviewed privacy/security pages.

last_funding.notes: Wellinks announced a $10 million first close of a Series B in August 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 Series B announcement is within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board has a Senior Data and BI Analyst role and no SDR, BDR, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable news index's newest dated item is the September 2, 2026 leadership/team announcement, not a product or major-feature launch. The six-month window begins May 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Wellinks announced Stephanie Solich as VP of Customer Success on August 31, 2026; her profile dates her Wellinks role from June 2026. The announcement also includes VP appointments/promotions.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live job board and public help center were readable but named no CRM or sales/marketing system.
